name: Turnstone
description: Runs tool-using AI agents on your own hardware with shell, file, search, and web tools, judge-graded approvals, and a cluster dashboard, using the models you choose.

skills.name: Built-in Agent Tools
skills.description: Runs shell commands, reads and edits files, searches, and fetches web pages as model tools, with approval before each call runs.

skills.name: Intent Validation
skills.description: Grades every tool call with an LLM judge running your model, giving a risk assessment and evidence before the call runs.

skills.name: Parallel Workstreams
skills.description: Runs parallel agent workstreams across cluster nodes, routed by the console's rendezvous proxy and shown on a live dashboard.

skills.name: Connect MCP Servers
skills.description: Connects external MCP tool servers with native deferred tool loading, or BM25 tool search as a fallback for other models.

skills.name: Discord and Slack Channels
skills.description: Routes conversations from Discord and Slack to agent workstreams through the Turnstone channel gateway and its adapters.
